facility.name: Luv-N-Care No. 3
facility.programs_provided: After School Care,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 16081 HENDERSON PASS, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78232

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: During the inspection the director was not available and at another location. The assistant director was unable to verify how the director attendance is tracked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report: A current gas inpsection was unavailable for review. The expiration date was 7/25/23. During the inspection the assistant director made an appointment for 6/30/26 with Big City Plumbing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Gas Inspection Report (26 TAC §746.801(13))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: School age children were observed to be freely watching Youtube videos. The video that was being watched appeared to be Spongebob with music dubbed over the scene.   This was corrected during the inspection when the tv was turned off.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: It was determined in an investigation that a caregiver was smoking on the operation property.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined that caregivers did not demonstrate good judgment and self-control when conversations between staff members, which were had in front of children, resulted in staff using curse words.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Staff were missing trainings in emergency preparedness, child abuse,  preventing communicable diseases, administering medication, responding to emergencies, building safety, and handling hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics: The director was missing training in SIDS/shaken baby/early brain development, emergency preparedness, preventing communicable diseases, administering medication, responding to emergencies, building safety, and handling hazardous materials.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Additional required topics (26 TAC §746.1311(e))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: The director did not immediately call EMS when an infant received a head injury severe enough to cause bleeding from the ear.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Based on the DFPS investigation, a video of the incident was observed. On the video a caregiver repeatedly put their hand on the chest of an 18-month-old child so the child would remain inactive for approximately 26 minutes. The child was required to remain seated and not allowed to get up or interact with other children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Based on the DFPS investigation, a video of the incident was observed. On the video a caregiver repeated grabbed an 18-month-old child from their upper arm and roughly sat them down.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Based on the DFPS investigation, a video of the incident was observed. On the video a child was observed coming out of the bathroom and not washing their hands before rejoining the class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods: Based on the DFPS investigation, a video of the incident was observed. On the video it was observed that a toddler class, with children 18 months to two years old, was required to sit in a group without an activity for approximately 26 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - No Long Waiting Periods (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver who was inactive was present in a room. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: The parents of a child who was in a situation that placed them at risk was not immediately notified.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: A child with known food allergies did not have an action plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Three of ten children's folders did not have an address listed for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two of ten children's files did not have a health care provider statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of ten children's files did not have a current immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: A first aid kit was missing tape and a thermometer.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §746.4003(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not demonstrate good judgment when they failed to use the required safety straps to buckle an infant into a highchair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Video shows that the safety straps were not used for a child who was placed in a highchair.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Video shows a caregiver failing to wash the hands of a child they diapered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: Video shows a caregiver not appropriately supervising an infant in a highchair when the caregiver is observed sitting down in a blind spot and not keeping the child in view.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed failing to wash their hands after diapering a child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - on Sides: Bucket swings in the toddler playground were found not having the 6 feet of use zone on the side of the adjacent swing and the fence.   *Swing was removed immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Bucket Swings - on Sides (26 TAC §746.4811(c))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Nine bottles, in the Lambs Classroom were not labeled with the child's first name and last initial.   *Note all bottles were labeled at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance: Based on interviews the operation was using threats for discipling purposes. Children were being told that if they did not behave they would be taken to a specific caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Discipline - Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance (26 TAC §746.2803(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt: The two playgrounds (12-18 months and 2 year old) in the operation were noted to have gravel covering concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4907(b))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: The operation did not provide an incident report for an injury that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Three out of three transportation vehicles fire extinguishers were not securely fastened. It was noted that the fire extinguishers were loose in the vehicles floors.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
